name: flames_entry
purpose: The only entry of FLAMES.OVL (32 bytes, level-2 overlay at 1000:a290). PUSH BP/SI/DI/DS, CALL a29e, POP, RET: returns AX = 0xa299 as produced by a29e, i.e. the code-segment offset of the first byte after the overlay. Called through vector 1778:057e by FONT_f032 (`if (g_unk_520c == 0) g_unk_520c = vec_FLAMES_a290()`), which then copies 0x1800 words from DS:0 to that offset: loading the tiny FLAMES overlay evicts any resident level-2 overlay (NPC/COMBAT/...), guaranteeing that 1000:a299.. (linear 0x1a299) is free to use as a 12 KB scratch buffer while the View/character creation runs. The other vectors the catalog lists (02f6 NPC, 05f6 COMBAT, 07b2 DNGLOOK) target the same address in other overlays and are not FLAMES.
notes: The decompiler shows FUN_1000_a29e(0x1f64) because of the PUSH DS; no argument is really passed.

name: flames_noop
proto: unsigned flames_noop(void)  /* returns own return address 0xa299 */
purpose: POP AX; PUSH AX; RET — loads its return address (1000:a299) into AX and returns, so the caller receives the offset just past FLAMES_a290.
